snapshot.coverage_definition: All publicly verifiable flood episode records in the window for which the cited source names a Hong Kong location, plus an area-level summary only when no locations were published.
limitations: Official incident totals can exceed the named location records because some releases publish only an aggregate count.
Coordinates are approximate visualization anchors and carry explicit spatial uncertainty; they are not surveyed flood points.
Rainfall and warning records without direct evidence of flooding are excluded from FloodEvent counts.

episodes.coverage_note: The Government reported six resolved flooding cases. Public reports named five locations or facilities represented here; the remaining case had no distinct public location in the cited material.
